en-UK.name: Beilu Web
en-UK.description: Web fetching capability — AI can access URLs and get page content.
en-UK.description_markdown: **Beilu Web** enables the AI to search the web via `<search>` and read pages via `<browse>` tags. Search/browse results are written into the chat history by default (persistent and visible); enable "inject once" (inject_once) in the web search settings to make results affect only the current turn without being saved to history.
en-UK.author: 凛倾

zh-CN.name: 联网搜索
zh-CN.description: 联网能力 — AI 访问 URL 获取网页内容
zh-CN.description_markdown: **联网搜索** 允许 AI 通过 `<search>` 搜索网页、`<browse>` 读取网页。搜索/浏览结果默认写入对话历史（持久可见）；在联网设置中勾选「仅本轮」（inject_once）后才只影响当轮生成、不写入历史。
zh-CN.author: 凛倾
